title: Evaluating Prompt-Driven Chinese Large Language Models: The Influence of Persona Assignment on Stereotypes and Safeguards
reasoning: The paper systematically benchmarks the Qwen model using 240 social groups categorized into 13 groups, one of which is 'Religion'. It specifically evaluates how persona assignment influences toxicity and refusal behavior towards religious groups (among others) to assess ethical alignment and safety safeguards.
